spells.procedure:
WOVEN THREADS — selected complete proposed procedure.
KEEP: Divination rank5, base10RP, Action,60feet,V/S/F, one perceived creature, WIS resistance, alteration of the genuinely last minute and Instantaneous duration. Retain all six actual class routes and their exact level gates. MC3-CAST-120, MC3-READY-120, MC3-MEMORY-120 and MC3-RECOVERY-120 apply only within their written scopes.
NEW temporal declaration: choose Erase or Replace and either FIXED absolute [a,b), 0<b-a<=60, or RELATIVE offsets [-u,-v),0<=v<u<=60. A direct cast anchors relative offsets at its legal commitment; a readied cast fixes those offsets at preparation but anchors them at its legal release. Explicit absolute timestamps never move. Freeze the resulting interval and payload before saves, private eligibility or interruption outcomes; no post-result retargeting. At the initial direct declaration or Ready preparation, the fixed interval must be within that then-eligible preceding minute; a knowingly impossible fixed plan is rejected before preparation/direct payment. A lawful fixed plan that subsequently ages is not rebound at release: its stated temporal payload check occurs at resolution after an otherwise legal release has spent its Reaction. The controller may decline release under ordinary Ready, but aging supplies no refund or replacement interval. A RELATIVE plan is instantiated at direct commitment or Ready release before private results, then remains fixed. At effect resolution t, revalidate against [t-60,t). Erase applies only the still-valid intersection and the actual experienced/event-selected portions inside it; a partly aged interval can therefore be partly erased with the same full payment. A wholly aged/empty intersection does nothing. Replace requires its ENTIRE fixed time interval still to lie inside the resolution window; partial aging makes that replacement fail wholly, because automatically trimming or retiming its narrative would change the fixed content. This asymmetry is explicit NEW scope, not a generic casting rule. A relative plan is anchored once, never slid again after a delay. Both temporal failures are paid when lawful commitment already occurred, give no new interval/target and no hidden diagnostic. Temporal validation is distinct from the recipient's private experience capacity.
Erase may select the whole interval or one clearly described event/facet predicate using at most60 ordinary whitespace-delimited words; an empty event description means the whole interval. Replace supplies one coherent first-person sensory narrative of at most60 such words covering no more than that fixed interval. Ordinary linguistic words count; identifiers/code/concatenation cannot bypass the content limit. The caster must actually know the described concepts, not the unknown original memory. It may assert false events using known concepts, but supplies no proficiency, formula, language, repertoire, genuine consent or factual omniscience. No hearing/shared language is needed for simple sensory content; semantic content the target cannot actually understand is not translated or taught. Replace changes only actual personally experienced eligible portions; absent experience/unconsciousness cannot become a training slot or an invented original. Preserve the entire declared narrative and record unsupported semantic facets privately rather than substituting a different story.
At resolution require actual creature, current perception/range/line of effect and memory capacity/protection eligibility. Roll one native WIS save if there is an otherwise operative mental application; success leaves recall unchanged. Failure applies the selected permissible change once. A hidden capacity/protection failure or nonexistent experience provides no readout, fallback event, prior timestamp or control effect. Actual suppression at the target prevents the local mental application before its payload; no save/overlay is invented for a fully suppressed output.
On successful application write a private source/owner/recipient/originalDC/root/event ledger and change accessible recollection instantly. There is no ongoing concentration, fixed expiry, repeated save or later dispellable field. Completed external events, physical records, resources, injuries, skills and independent commands persist. No caster success notification or forced future decision is added. Preserve all earlier memory provenance under later edits. Shared recovery can subsequently remove this family's supported portions against the highest relevant originalDC without restoring an independent Disrupt Memory loss. Ended or recovered history remains stored; death/revival, ordinary rest and loading are not replay/reset permissions.

completeHistoricalEarlierRecord.procedure:
KEEP Action, 30 feet, V/S/F, all targets forgetting the last minute, INT resistance and instantaneous resolution. NEW center one 30-foot-radius sphere on the caster. Snapshot every creature in the sphere with caster-origin line of effect, including the caster and allies; no selective omission or individual-perception requirement. A hidden creature can be affected without being revealed. Each makes INT. Success leaves memory unchanged. Failure removes accessible firsthand episodic recall of experiences during the 60 elapsed seconds immediately preceding resolution, but only experiences that the creature actually had. Unconscious intervals with no experience, absent witnesses and beings without the relevant memory capacity do not acquire fabricated experiences or a substitute older interval. No shared language or sight of the spell is needed; actual mental/memory protections retain their scope.

NEW this is an instantaneous lasting memory change, not a one-minute ongoing fog. There is no concentration, expiry, concealed area, visual obscuration, continuing entrant effect, replacement narrative or private-memory readout. Ordinary dispelling or later antimagic does not undo a completed alteration. The recipient cannot recall a newly heard password solely through the erased experience, but existing independent older knowledge and external notes remain available. General identity, trained proficiencies, actual class/repertoire grants, completed legitimate training and older memories are not deleted merely because the creature used or thought about them during that minute. Events, injuries, statuses, resources, consumptions, actions, contracts and all other people's unaffected evidence remain real. This source does not independently end concentration; Disrupt Memory's explicit concentration-ending clause is not a universal memory rule.

Record the actual original episode/event provenance before applying the inaccessible-memory layer. Each new cast has its own resolution-relative last-minute window. Erasing a present recollection of yesterday does not erase yesterday's underlying memory, and revisiting an older fabricated story cannot reset its event date. Repeated paid casts over genuinely passing time can affect additional genuinely recent intervals; this source supplies no overall one-minute lifetime cap, but it also supplies no backdated or recursive reach. Empty or protected portions give no hidden diagnostic and cannot be substituted with another person's experiences. Actual noticing of a gap, suspicion, testimony and investigation remain possible without an automatic identification of the caster.

NEW recovery proposal: a genuinely applicable effect expressly restoring altered memories uses its own procedure. Otherwise, after encountering specific credible independent evidence contradicting the alteration or establishing an erased event, the recipient may spend ten uninterrupted minutes examining that episode and make WIS/Insight. Use the highest original spell DC among currently operative Haze of Forgetting and Woven Threads alterations covering the selected episode. Ordinary task degrees apply: Success/Critical Success restores the actual originally experienced portion; failure provides no false certainty, and a retry needs materially new evidence or method. The same unsupported assertion is not infinite retries. This shared recovery rule is an explicit proposed extension to the prior unadopted Woven Threads draft, requiring joint agreement; it is not silently applied as a reviewed correction.

On successful recovery under this new shared rule, remove the current Haze/Woven overlays over the recovered portion and restore the true original episode, not an earlier adversary's invented layer. Unrelated intervals and other named memory effects retain their own rules. Disrupt Memory's reviewed six-second firsthand loss does not gain this new evidence-restoration permission merely by overlap; if that independent effect still removes a portion, learning evidence can create new knowledge without overriding its own recovery rules. Death/revival, rests, initiative changes and recasts do not reset the retained memory provenance. The spell dictates no future belief or decision based on the missing interval and cannot manufacture consent by making someone forget an objection.
workedCases: EN6-02-A: At elapsed time 120, the caster and three witnesses stand inside the 30-foot sphere. All four make INT, including the caster. Failed saves affect their actually experienced interval from time 60 up to resolution at 120. A witness asleep for the first thirty seconds loses only actual later experience. The spilled ink, spent RP, wounds and a written receipt remain unchanged; the spell supplies neither a replacement story nor an announcement of which hidden witnesses failed.

EN6-02-B: A genuine episode is covered by a DC16 Haze layer and a DC18 Woven Threads alteration. With credible independent evidence, ten minutes of examination uses Insight DC18 under the explicitly new shared recovery proposal. Success restores the true experienced portion and removes those two proposal-family overlays; it does not erase an independent Disrupt Memory prohibition or grant facts never observed. A later low-DC recast cannot lower this recovery DC or use a present recollection to reach older original events.
